mission: Prepare a measurable B2B demand program for a validated offer and a human-capable sales handoff without launching outreach or campaigns.

conditions: A validated B2B motion, measurable funnel, qualification definition, and human follow-up capacity exist.

requirements: Defines offer, buying context, goal, qualification, and capacity.
Pipeline stages, owner, SLA, and follow-up capacity are explicit.

outputs.purpose: Defines a review-ready campaign, qualification, handoff, tracking, guardrails, and no-send activation boundary.

quality_rules: Lead volume is not success without quality.
Do not launch without human follow-up capacity.
Attribution is a model, not objective truth.
All external configurations remain local drafts.
stop_conditions: Offer or B2B motion is unvalidated.
Qualification or human capacity is missing.
The task requests outreach, upload, or campaign activation.
